early: Strict initial pool Batch1-2. Greedy ascending Batch allocation per gas.
spread: Round-robin equal counts across existing gas-Batch cells, capacity capped; ascending tie.
recent: Greedy descending Batch allocation per gas. No future samples.
budget_definition: 25%,50%,100% (floor per gas) of Batch1-2 gas counts. Max means largest under strict early pool, NOT dataset maximum. Identical six gas counts across schemes and folds at each budget.
sampling: Fixed per-cell SeedSequence(seed,gas,Batch) permutation prefixes. No replacement. Spread budgets nested. Same row subsets across C contrasts.
primary: Five-seed average of equal-weight Fold6/7/8 Macro F1; also report each Fold.
consistent_effect: Descriptive only: paired delta mean >=0.005, each of three Fold mean deltas >0 and at least4/5 seed-level equal-Fold deltas >0. Not a significance test or future generalization claim. Report all negative effects.
protection: Separately flag any gas mean Recall drop >0.05, other-four mean F1 drop >0.02, or increased gas-Fold zero Recall pairs vs spread_mid. No best setting or seed selection; ties yield no superiority conclusion.
anchor: Counterfactual common median imputer and StandardScaler fitted once on all Batch1-2 (1689 rows), strictly past all Validation. Additional unsupervised training reference beyond selected classifier rows; C contrasts are NOT matched total information-budget experiments.
weight: balanced from selected Train labels; fixed unit dict {1..6:1.0} as equal-penalty control. No sample_weight. Same gas budgets imply identical balanced weights within A. Rounding may alter weights slightly across B budgets.
gamma: gamma=scale always. Native standardization gives1/128; common anchor may change actual gamma via Train transformed variance. C preprocessing effect includes automatic bandwidth change, not isolated scaler-only causal effect.
future: After historical findings frozen, reuse20 Fold C models; evaluate9/10 and pooled. No new future-fit, winner, seed choice or tuning. Stored A/B only unmatched-size reference table. No new independent Test.
uncertainty: Seed SD(ddof=1) describes subset randomness only. Folds overlap, seeds share data and cell permutations; no IID repeated-trial claim or p-value.
missing: Unsupported gas-Batch cells stay0 support, never synthetic rows. Unavailable comparisons are NA, not performance0.
compute_budget: 120 SVC fits of419-1689 rows,128 features. No search/early stopping. All five seeds retained. Historical full-data SVC runs suggest manageable CPU cost.
